meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 分组可选择由 OpenAI 的 Codex 当智能体后台,代替 Claude 做规划、调用工具、保存和恢复会话。密钥只存 OneCLI 保险库,不留在配置里。
howto.when: 当你把某个分组的 provider 设为 codex 并重启该分组后,该组的任务改由 Codex 处理;也可把默认提供方改成 codex,只影响之后新建的分组。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw groups can use OpenAI's Codex as the agent backend instead of Claude. Codex handles planning, tool calls, MCP tools, and server-side conversation history with session resume. Credentials stay in the OneCLI vault only.
howto.when_en: When you set a group's provider to codex and restart that group, the group's tasks run on Codex. Optionally, changing the instance default to codex affects only groups created afterward.

say_en.text: Switch group demo's provider to codex, then restart it.
say_en.note: Runs the per-group switch and restart.

say_en.text: Check whether Codex is installed and fill in any missing files.
Make codex the default provider for new groups.
say_en.note: Sets the default and restarts NanoClaw.
